She has developed unexplained lymphadenopathy in the bilateral cervical chains over the past eight weeks. Nodes are firm, non-tender, and increasing in size. Her parents have noticed increasing pallor over the same period. On examination there are petechiae scattered over her legs and lower trunk. No fever today. No rash beyond the petechiae. The adult pathway is not appropriate for this patient given her age.

Recent blood count shows anaemia and low platelet count. Fasting glucose level was checked and is within normal limits.
